backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that stores email addresses in a Set and exposes a public saveEmail function for collecting user signups.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implementation of seven landing page sections (hero, features, how-it-works, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, email signup) with high confidence and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the landing page components, hooks, and configuration for NextHire AI.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode theme variables for a neutral/grayscale design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component that composes the complete landing page by rendering Header, seven section components, and Footer in sequence.
frontend/src/components/EmailSignupSecti: Email signup form component with validation, React Query mutation to save emails via backend actor, and loading/success/error states.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with six expandable questions about NextHire AI's features, pricing, security, and differentiation.
Features grid displaying three key capabilities (AI Resume Builder, ATS Checker, Job Tracker) with icons, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with brand info, navigation links (Product, Company, Legal), social media icons, and copyright notice. Includes smooth scrolling to page sections and dynamic year display.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed header navigation component with responsive mobile menu, smooth scrolling to page sections (Features, How It Works, Pricing, FAQ), and a "Get Started" CTA button.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with headline, subheadline, CTA buttons, background image with gradient overlay, and social proof statistics (10,000+ resumes, 95% ATS pass rate, 4.9/5 rating).
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Four-step process section explaining how NextHire AI works: Upload Resume, AI Analysis, ATS Optimization, and Track Applications, displayed in a grid layout with icons.
frontend/src/components/PricingSection.t: Pricing section displaying three tiers (Free, Pro, Enterprise) with features, pricing, and CTAs. Pro plan is highlighted as "Most Popular" with scale effect.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Testimonials section displaying three user reviews with 5-star ratings, profile images, names, roles, and quotes about their experience with NextHire AI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous actor using Internet Identity, with React Query caching and automatic query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks file for backend operations, currently containing a placeholder useExample hook; actual backend queries to be added as needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a blue and white color theme for both light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom colors using OKLCH, Inter font family, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining NextHire AI landing page structure with blue/white theme, listing completed features (hero, features, how-it-works, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, email signup) and required placeholder images.
